breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth removed the incorrect instruction to use a constant peak moment. The Agent, however, explicitly included and followed this incorrect instruction, stating: 'The bending moment M(x) is taken as constant and equal to the peak value M = P × L over the entire span from x = 0 to x = L.'
